title: Initialize CredentialRegistry Pallet
details: Implement extrinsics and storage for issuing, updating, and revoking credentials. Support hashing metadata for on-chain proof.

title: Implement AuditScrapbook Pallet
details: Accept audit log hashes, timestamp them, emit events, and store extrinsic references for traceability.

title: IdentityBinding Pallet
details: Bind provider DID to NPI hash. Support updates, rotations, and event logs.

title: DelegatedIssuance Pallet
details: Allow on-chain issuer → delegate trust relationships. Support revocation and modification.

title: StatusListBitstring Pallet
details: Implement revocation status list for credentials. Provide compact bitmap storage.

title: Deploy Multi-Node Validator Network
details: Configure 3–5 validators, TLS RPC, metrics, KMS signing, and monitoring dashboards.

title: Chain RPC Client
details: Implement polkadot.js client wrapper with retry logic, health checks, and fallback for chain lag.

title: Anchor Submission Queue
details: Queue VC anchors, retry failures, batch submissions, and expose job status to APIs.

title: Chain Event Listener
details: Subscribe to chain events and push them to WebSocket channels for mobile/web clients.

title: OIDC4VCI Token Endpoint
details: Implement issuance token exchange for VC delivery. Support preAuthCode and PIN flows.

title: OIDC4VP Verification Endpoint
details: Verify SD-JWT tokens, validate nonce, check revocation, and assemble verification evidence.

title: VC Metadata Endpoint
details: Return metadata: type, issuer, expiration, schemaVersion, anchorStatus, revocation status.

title: Provider Profile API
details: Aggregate VCs, PSV results, privileges, sanctions, FitScore, and return combined profile state.

title: Evidence Graph Builder
details: Link VCs to PSV events, attachments, chain anchors, prior credential versions.

title: Provider Identity Sync
details: Bind provider DID, update NPI hash, handle profile edits from mobile or web.

title: Wallet Storage Engine
details: Store credential files encrypted, maintain indexes, support schema migrations.

title: VC Viewer Core
details: Display VC fields, claims grouped by schema, anchor details, issuer metadata, and attachments.

title: SD-JWT Presentation Flow
details: Enable selective disclosure toggles, sign SD-JWT with device key, present via QR or deep link.

title: Profile UI Sync
details: Ensure profile updates instantly reflect backend state with optimistic UI and rollback on conflict.

title: Deep-Link Login
details: Support universal links to authorize the wallet when accessed from web employer portals.

title: Issuer Portal Framework
details: Implement navigation, role-based routing, session storage, and secure API client.

title: Credential Issuance Form
details: UI for issuers to input credential data, validate required fields, preview VC before issuance.

title: Credential Revocation UI
details: Allow issuer to revoke VC, select reason code, and trigger anchor update.

title: Issuer Bulk Upload Wizard
details: Parse CSVs, auto-match providers, preview issuance actions, detect duplicates.

title: Bulk Issuance Pipeline
details: Batch creation of VCs, queue anchor submissions, return job state and progress.

title: Job Posting API
details: Allow employers to create jobs with credential requirements, privileges, specialty, and telehealth rules.

title: FitScore Computation Engine
details: Compute FitScore using job requirements + provider credentials + privileges + experience + sanctions + recency.

title: IntentScore Engine
details: Train model on provider preferences (location, schedule, comp) to enhance job matching.

title: Match Ranking API
details: Return ranked candidate list for employer job postings using FitScore+IntentScore.

title: Employer Dashboard Framework
details: Dashboard shell, navigation, authentication, multi-role support.
